USD.note: Fed held 3.75-4.00% with two hike dissents; Q3 GDP 3.4% beat 3.2%. December hike odds fell to ~73%, below what data and the dissents imply.

EUR.note: ECB held 2.50% but Lagarde kept December open (~75-84% priced). Oil up ~11% in four weeks weighs; the French budget vote on 3 Nov keeps fiscal risk live.

GBP.note: Budget met the rules and gilts eased (10Y ~5.29%); a 5 Nov BoE hike to 4.00% is fully priced. Fiscal risk easing is the main new support.

JPY.note: BoJ held 1.25% 8-1 and raised FY2027 core CPI to 2.6%, but Ueda gave no December signal; odds ~57%. MoF warned on 27 Oct; oil +11% hurts.

CHF.note: SNB at 0% with ~12% priced for a December hike leaves the lowest carry. A neutral risk regime removes last week's haven offset.

CAD.note: BoC hiked to 2.50% and said more could be needed, but August GDP was flat (0.0% vs +0.2%); December ~57% priced. Oil up, US tariffs live.

AUD.note: RBA at 4.60% is the highest carry; a 3 Nov hike is ~80% priced after trimmed mean 1.0% beat the RBA's 0.8%. All four major banks expect a hike.

NZD.note: RBNZ held 2.75% 4-3 against hike pricing; Breman sees a December hike as likely (~77% priced). Dairy +3.7%; jobs data 4 Nov and a 7 Nov election.

XAU.note: Gold factor G = 0: real yields fell ~25bp but USD repricing caps X1; breakevens flat; ETF outflows offset central-bank buying. XAU = G + USD = +5.
